metadata.title: Wak Arobak | Pork with Arobak leaves | Garo Recipe

Arobak scientifically known as Antidesma acidum Retz. is a shrub or tree growing up to 10 meters. The leaves of this tree is consumed locally as a food and medicine. 

The young and tender leaves  have a sour taste and are used for cooking and as a medicine it is used to treat dysentery, bile problems, dropsy, muscular pains, pneumonia, sore and bite of rabid dogs.  

This dish is a simple dish of pork cooked with the tender leaves of Arobak plant, the distinct sourness of the plant gives it a nice tangy  flavour and is an amazing side for steamed rice.
